description: The chart illustrates measured “effect” values for four morphosyntactic tags (case, gender, number, tense) across six model/metric conditions shown in the legend. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “tag,” with categories ordered left to right as case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 (the plotted range extends slightly below 0 and above 20), and each bar includes a vertical error bar with caps indicating variability around the bar height. For each tag, six adjacent bars are grouped: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). In the case group, the bars are approximately 6 (mBERT-L₂), ~5.5 (XLM-L₂), ~2.8 (mBERT-R₂), ~2.1 (XLM-R₂), ~12.3 (mBERT-B₂), and ~11.2 (XLM-B₂), with relatively large error bars on several series. In the gender group, the bars are about ~1.4 (mBERT-L₂), ~0.3 (XLM-L₂), ~1.8 (mBERT-R₂), ~1.1 (XLM-R₂), ~4.2 (mBERT-B₂), and ~3.4 (XLM-B₂). In the number group, the bars are roughly ~1.2 (mBERT-L₂), ~0.8 (XLM-L₂), ~1.0 (mBERT-R₂), ~0.6 (XLM-R₂), ~2.7 (mBERT-B₂), and ~2.3 (XLM-B₂). In the tense group, all bars are near zero, approximately ~0.4 (mBERT-L₂), ~0.0 (XLM-L₂), ~−0.1 (mBERT-R₂), ~−0.2 (XLM-R₂), ~0.5 (mBERT-B₂), and ~0.6 (XLM-B₂), again with error bars shown for each. The bars are not presented as sorted by magnitude; they are arranged consistently by legend order within each tag group, and no individual bars appear specially highlighted beyond their distinct colors and the presence of error bars.
